apworld_description: Flippermizer Base Game builds a seed-selected episode from a larger weekly world catalog.
Its goal is to pull a custom active table set from the broader pool, then link only those chosen tables together for progression, checks, hints, flyers, and boss routing.
This branch is the definitive Flippermizer AP Manual path and carries the seed-time scaffolding needed for active world-set generation and slot-data payloads.
Weekly world swaps are handled by curating five-table worlds into the catalog and selecting them through YAML.
